thread:
Emma: Heads-up — ACME enterprise POC is hitting intermittent 503s from the frontdoor during the RLHF eval run, started ~10:23 PT. ~20–30% of requests failing, tail latency spikes. Can SRE/runtime triage? :eyes:
Sam: Thanks — how urgent from sales? Any screenshots/logs yet?
Emma: Customer says it blocks their demo today, they're ramping traffic to ~60 rps. Attached link to live logs: https://logs.redwood.example/streams/ACME/210123 — they flagged repeated 503 and then a bunch of backend timeouts. :rotating_light:
Priya: I'm seeing autoscale events aligned with the spike. Cooldown + node provisioning laged ~25–40s, backend pool exhausted. Snippet from frontdoor: ```[2026-03-21T17:23:12Z] frontdoor:error 503 no backend capacity (pool=demo-gpu-pool-7)```
Luca: Likely combined with large sequence lengths and current continuous batching config. When batch queue grows but new GPU pods aren't up we hit a short window of rejects. Can we temporarily reduce max_batch_size and bump min_replicas for the demo pool?
Nora: Can you paste a quick repro curl so I can replay locally against staging? Also need the model + seq len.
Emma: Repro (from customer): ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer x***' -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"m-rlhf-16b","input":"<very long prompt>"}'``` They said seq len ≈ 8k tokens.
Sam: Long seqs + batching explains the lag. Quick mitigation: route demo to a quantized lower-memory variant and set min_replicas=2 for the pool. I'll push a routing override now.
Luca: Suggested patch (ops CLI): ```rictl update pool demo-gpu-pool-7 --min-replicas 2 --max-batch-size 8``` That should reduce tail queuing. Also consider temporary routing to m-rlhf-16b-q8 as fallback.
Priya: Applied min_replicas bump and added an alert rule for pool saturation. infra-bot: autoscale:event created id=as-8492; alert=pool-saturation-demo; severity=high.
infra-bot: Deploy note: routing override to m-rlhf-16b-q8 applied for customer ACME (ttl=30m).
Luca: Observed OOMs in one old node during scaleup: ```kubelet: eviction: OOMKill container=runtime-worker pid=4245``` — garbage collection didn't free KV cache fast enough. We'll evict idle KV less aggressively on demo nodes.
Sam: I'll open an internal ticket (ENG-XXXX) to track: failover path not gracefully converting heavy seq requests to smaller variants in the short autoscale window. Also adding a canary for the routing override behavior.
Emma: I'll tell the AE and customer: we applied fallback to q8 variant and increased pool min_replicas; monitoring now. Please post updates here and we want a follow-up call at 3pm PT to walk through the fix. :thumbsup:
Priya: Monitoring shows 503 rate dropped from ~24% -> ~1.5% after routing override. Keeping alert on for 1 hour.
Nora: Replayed the customer's curl against staging with the routing override — no 503s, stable latency at tail. Will collect logs for postmortem.
Sam: Next steps: postmortem (root cause autoscale + batching + KV eviction interplay), short-term recommendation for POCs (min_replicas>=2 for long-seq RLHF, max_batch_size<=8), and a runtime change to make failover variant conversion faster. Assigning ENG-XXXX to Luca/Priya.
Emma: Great, thanks everyone. I'll update ACME and set the 3pm call. :lock:
